name: Create Attachment
description: Creates an Attachment on a parent object. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_attachment.htm)

configurable_props.name: docsInfo
configurable_props.content: [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_attachment.htm) for more information on available fields.

configurable_props.name: Name
configurable_props.label: File Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the attached file. Max 255 characters.

configurable_props.name: filePathOrContent
configurable_props.label: File Path, URL or Content
configurable_props.description: The file to attach. Provide either a file URL, a path to a file in the `/tmp` directory (for example, `/tmp/myFile.txt`), or base64-encoded file data.

configurable_props.name: ContentType
configurable_props.label: Content Type
configurable_props.description: The content type (MIME type) of the attachment. For example, `image/png`.

configurable_props.name: ParentId
configurable_props.label: Parent ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the parent object of the attachment. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.228.0.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_attachment.htm) for supported objects.

configurable_props.name: Description
configurable_props.label: Description
configurable_props.description: Description of the attachment. Max 500 characters.

configurable_props.name: IsPrivate
configurable_props.label: Private
configurable_props.description: Whether this record is viewable only by the owner and administrators (true) or viewable by all otherwise-allowed users (false).

configurable_props.name: OwnerId
configurable_props.label: Owner ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the user who owns the attachment.
